prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: 1024x1024 marketplace plugin icon
Primary request: Create a premium minimal bitmap icon for evidence-backed technology selection and dated decision intelligence.
Subject: one bold compass lens containing three clean branching paths that converge on a single highlighted choice, suggesting contextual comparison rather than a universal ranking.
Style/medium: polished modern app icon, vector-friendly but rendered as a high-quality bitmap, flat geometric foreground with restrained dimensional polish.
Composition/framing: centered, one dominant readable silhouette, at most three meaningful foreground groups, generous safe area, readable at 32x32.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed rounded-square app-icon background built around deep navy #163A5F.
Color palette: high-contrast warm ivory main mark, restrained mint and amber accents, all meaningful foreground elements at least 3:1 against the background.
Materials/textures: crisp filled shapes, subtle depth, no busy texture, no photo material, no UI screenshot.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: no visible letters, words, numbers, score badges, tiny dots, thin-line illustration, proprietary logos, product UI, watermark, private names, or ranking podium.
Avoid: generic radar sweep, stock analytics chart, mascot, detailed circuit board, technology-logo collage, skeuomorphic clutter, low contrast, and text inside the icon.
checks: save the selected image into the plugin workspace as assets/icon.png
inspect the image at 1024, 64, and 32 px
reject visible text, ranking numbers, tiny details, screenshots, photos, watermarks, copied logos, or low contrast
wire interface.composerIcon, interface.logo, and interface.brandColor after the file exists
